title: Mass and rest energy
hook: Change rest mass and predict rest energy.
misconception: rest energy stays fixed when rest mass doubles.
objective: Apply E₀ = mc² to compare rest energy when rest mass changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With the same constant speed of light, E₀ = mc². When rest mass doubles, rest energy becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model E₀ = mc²; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider the same constant speed of light, with a nonzero initial result. If rest mass triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on rest energy?
recall.why: Apply E₀ = mc² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
